title: Japan, ASEAN launch AI safety, security partnership
summary: Japan and the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) have launched a partnership to address the threats brought by artificial intelligence (AI) in the region, Japanese Prime Minister Sanae…

blocks.text: Japan and the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) have launched a partnership to address the threats brought by artificial intelligence (AI) in the region, Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi announced Tuesday.

"In order to address new vulnerabilities associated with rapid development of AI, Japan-ASEAN AI Safety and Security Partnership was just launched," Sanae Takaichi said during her opening speech at the ASEAN-Japan Summit.
Under its three pillars of ASEAN-Japan Comprehensive Strategic Plane, Sanae Takaichi shared that Japan will promote the JAPAN-ASEAN AI co-creation initiative.
The initiative aims to strengthen government-to-government and industry-academia collaborations under the following pillars:

items: human resources development and capacity building

blocks.text: Finance Secretary Frederick Go earlier underscored the implementation of ASEAN’s Digital Economy Framework Agreement (DEFA) and semiconductor roadmap as key steps toward attracting artificial intelligence investments and creating better jobs.
Go identified reliable electricity, predictable regulations and fiscal discipline as essential to securing long-term AI investments, particularly in energy-intensive data centers.
He also cited a target of $34 billion in public and private investment under the Philippines’ AI Infrastructure Master Plan through 2033.
Meanwhile, President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. underscored Japan's recognition to the ASEAN centrality.
"As partners for peace and stability, ASEAN values Japan's support for ASEAN centrality and the ASEAN outlook on the Indo-Pacific," Marcos said during his opening speech.

"We also value our cooperation through the ASEAN Defense Ministers' Meeting, plus the Japan-ASEAN Ministerial Initiative for Enhanced Defense Cooperation, and our joint work against transnational crime, online scams, and cyber threats," he added.
According to the ASEAN website, Japan's relationship with the ASEAN was established in 1997.
Among the first ASEAN's dialogue partners, Japan consistently features as the region's Top 10 trading partners. — RSJ, GMA News
